notes.title: Dann Fox & The Time Machine is here!
notes.content:
Fight, Jump, Run!
Dann Fox & The Time Machine is a third person action platformer with fast paced combat, beautiful levels to explore and lots of secrets to unlock!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218716/fe8fbdb0cfb3dc0c66658d861880b2289b42b5c5.png

Combat
Beat your enemies up with a simple and fast combat system! Choose your weapon and upgrade it with a variety of different power ups!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218716/88db7e96e4b036f970d04708f15644e28e2a013e.png

Levels
Jump, roll and run your way through the platforming challenges of the levels! Each containing obstacles like falling and moving platforms, deadly spikes and rolling boulders!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218716/c5997cbe1360e8ace9998e90377292fc30d2f6ed.png
